title: Surviving cohomology of the coefficient shifted Tate constant
statement: Fix a purity finite field and coefficient setting P [def-pur-conventions, def-weil-finite-field-fiber] and a separated finite-type arithmetic scheme X_0 over Spec(P.field.k_0). Use the actual common-stage coefficient Weil heart [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex, def-weil-constructible-heart] and its signed standard cohomology functors [def-sf-canonical-coefficient-weil-cohomology]. For every natural d, coefficient H^(-2d) of twistedConstant(P,X_0,d) [lem-sf-native-coefficient-cohomology-comparison] is isomorphic in the coefficient Weil heart to the unshifted commonWeilSheaf of twist d [def-weil-frobenius-coefficient-twists]. This intertwines canonicalSourceTheta with the actual root-line Frobenius. There is no native category or exceptional endpoint.

proof.text: Compose sourceUnit with identification of the regular scalar unit and the reconstructed tensor unit, then the tensor right unitor. This identifies the carrier with the root line shifted by 2d.
The root line lies in the standard heart. The truncation counit and unit at degree -2d are isomorphisms on its 2d shift; applying the prescribed -2d shift recovers the unshifted line.

Expand canonicalSourceTheta. Pullback-unit compatibility and right-unitor naturality remove its unit factor. The normalized truncation and shift comparisons carry shiftedLineTheta to commonDerivedLineMap. This intertwining carrier isomorphism lifts to the full coefficient Weil heart.
